chronological_fold_design.candidate_clock: feature source time <= generation start <= generation completion <= freeze commit <= persist acknowledgement < original candidate cutoff.
chronological_fold_design.design: One fixed next-day Grade-R engineering card; no fitting, backtest, ROI, threshold, or policy search.
chronological_fold_design.history_clock: Only completed races dated on or before 2026-08-02 and strictly before the 2026-08-09 target may enter history features.
chronological_fold_design.late_race_rule: A target whose original cutoff passes before persistence remains in the denominator as deterministic no-bet and is never backfilled.
chronological_fold_design.real_data_rule: No real bridge parse, inference, candidate, quote, result, payout, or ROI command may run during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE; synthetic fixtures only.

data_as_of: EXP028 passed 32/32 tests, then failed closed before runner snapshot finalization because history_date_max was 20260801 while the fixed minimum was 20260802. Read-only audit found the missing EXP019 bridge artifacts unchanged in the prior execution worktree: 459 official result rows across 36 races with zero duplicate race-horse identities, plus the matching combined entry bridge. No candidate ledger, quote, result, ROI, BUY, order, dashboard, or notification side effect occurred in EXP028.
hypothesis: The EXP028 freshness failure is entirely explained by two previously approved EXP019 bridge artifacts not being inherited into the successor worktree; verifying and binding those exact artifacts before inference is sufficient for the unchanged EXP028 runner to complete all 36 races.
in_scope: Add a fail-fast bridge-manifest verifier that checks the exact EXP019 recent-result and entry artifacts before baseline inference
After a distinct APPROVED_TO_RUN grant, execute the fixed card once and produce research-only candidate freeze artifacts
Bind the EXP019 2026-08-02 result bridge with 459 runner rows, 36 races, zero duplicate race-horse identities, and SHA-256 ead9264ecc8add5c3de49f65ed9006ac5a653bc6d9bf67f491a33342d30c240d
Bind the EXP019 combined entry bridge with SHA-256 2d987623b2be36e9eed451fb5b1e0dd0db6fff189f3b67374711f71908022023
Create EXP029 identity-only config and target manifests while preserving all EXP028 model, feature, calibrator, threshold, candidate, tie-break, race, runner, and cutoff values
Keep all candidate generation independent of odds, popularity, payout, market rank, and results from 2026-08-09
Keep formal_buy false, send_order false, stake zero, dashboard mutation false, notification false, credential access false, order imports disabled, and ROI calculation disabled
Run only synthetic bridge-manifest, hash, denominator, date, compatibility, and safety tests during APPROVED_TO_PREPARE

Every direct previous-race field retains source file, source record identity, source race date, and canonical record hash

null_hypothesis: The exact bridge artifacts do not produce history_date_max 20260802, their identities or hashes drift, the fixed runner still fails, or any predictive, market, threshold, production, BUY, or order change is required.
out_of_scope: Any alternative pair, ticket type, race, or stake search

primary_metric.baseline: EXP028 stopped at history_date_max 20260801 because the two fixed EXP019 bridge artifacts were absent from its worktree.
primary_metric.evaluation: The bridge preflight passes before inference; history_date_max is 20260802; all 495 runners and 36 races terminate exactly once; all probability, source-time, domain, and safety contracts pass.
primary_metric.name: history_bridge_and_terminal_candidate_completeness

purge_embargo.history_cutoff: No history row dated 2026-08-09 or later may enter target features.
purge_embargo.market_firewall: No odds, popularity, market rank, payout, ROI, or derivative may influence candidate selection, confidence, tie-break, or abstention.
purge_embargo.post_event_embargo: No missed candidate cutoff may be repaired with later information.
purge_embargo.target_selection_embargo: All 36 target race identities and 495 runners remain fixed independently of market and results.

racing_mechanism: The frozen basic-ability features require completed prior-race outcomes through 2026-08-02. The missing bridge supplies only official prior outcomes and their matching pre-race horse identities; it changes no feature definition, score, candidate ranking, calibrator, confidence threshold, or value rule.
raw_data_sources: EXP023 frozen M1C coherent Top3-set inference bundle, baseline model/config, C0 offset action calibrator, confidence threshold 0.21275851149504352, candidate policy, and tie-break
rejection_gate: Any bridge path, hash, row count, race count, duplicate count, or date bound differs from the bridge manifest
Any current result, odds, popularity, market, payout, ROI, dashboard, notification, credential, BUY, stake, or order side effect reaches candidate generation
Any mapped history row violates the strict target-date cutoff
Any model, feature set, calibrator, candidate policy, confidence threshold, value policy, or tie-break changes
Any of the 495 runners is absent, duplicated, or mapped to a different target identity
Any probability contract violation is accepted
Any registered target disappears or any obstacle or source-contract-failed race becomes candidate-ready
Any synthetic bridge or runner test fails
stop_conditions: Any additional predictive, market, threshold, or production change is required
Any bridge or direct-history source contract would need weakening
Any late race would need backfill or a cutoff would need weakening
Any result, market, credential, notification, dashboard mutation, formal BUY, nonzero stake, or order-capable path is encountered
The exact synthetic test command fails
The fixed real-data command exits before all 36 targets reach deterministic terminal records
target_population: All 36 fixed races and 495 runners on the 2026-08-09 Sapporo, Niigata, and Chukyo cards. Every race remains in the denominator. Chukyo 9R remains deterministic no-bet because obstacle races are unsupported.
